claim: Villagers wear Coats when they are cold. A Coat is gear for the Heat need (BaseValueIncrease 129, against 79 for the other need gear), not a consumable, which is why its resource record stores no need units.

evidence.reference: Maintainer report, 26 October 2026, from play. Decoded gear config for Coat (source 297369): Need Heat, BaseValueIncrease 129, exact round-trip (research handoff, gear_findings). The Coat ResourceConfig stores zero units for every need.

notes: What a BaseValueIncrease of 129 does to the Heat meter (Heat need: satisfied at 90, max 150) and whether a Coat wears out are not yet traced; the runtime application of gear is unresolved in the research handoff. Whether worn Coats still count toward 'Sew N Coats' objectives is a Part C check.
